name: Mortar
dimensions: Height 9.8 cm; Width 5.3 cm; Diameter 9 cm
summary: Ivory was used for making small functional items such as brush-pots, boxes and vessels. This mortar belongs to a group which is not visibly related to any other type of seventeenth century Chinese object, although the dragons and phoenixes striding round the upper and lower bands are of the Chinese
